Condition : 2 - The operations consisted of the use of the property as a small House of Multiple Occupation (HMO) under C4 Use Class, in that the residential unit was in use by up to six unrelated people prior to the adoption of the Article 4 Direction on November 17th 2022. The development constitutes permitted development within the meaning of Class L of Part 3 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and complied with the development tolerances set out in said Class L.

Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that this certificate relates solely to the use of the premises for a maximum occupancy of six residents irrespective of any other documentation or other licences applied for or issued by the Council. The occupation of the premises by more than six persons would require planning permission.
